messages:
kim: heads-up — aegir14b (int4) canary showed intermittent OOMs when handling mixed short+very-long-gen traffic today, rolling back the canary.
noah: any logs or quick pattern?
kim: paste log snippet:
```
2026-04-02T11:08:09Z WARN  kv_cache: slots_grown=+12 total_slots=624
2026-04-02T11:08:09Z ERROR oom: alloc failed attention_kv shm=1320000000
2026-04-02T11:08:09Z INFO  request id=Qp7 gen_tokens=1800 route=aegir14b-int4
```
dina: 1800 tokens + prefetch_window=2 + default batch=4 is a known combustion pattern for int4. slot count explodes.
raf: quick mitigation we can push to canary config: reduce route default max_new_tokens -> 600, prefetch_window -> 1, batch_size -> 2, enable soft_eviction. keeps perf sane and reduces slot tail.
noah: agree. also enable compactor_interval_s=300 for that GPU pool during canary. compactor helps reclaim fragmented slot space.
dina: I'll add an automated rule: if free_slot_ratio < 0.2 then temporarily disable prefetch for new requests for 60s. cheap safety net.
kim: good. we should also add a routing fallback: if requested max_new_tokens >= 1024 then send to aegir14b-int8. reduces blast radius for heavy users.
raf: diagnostics to collect during the next run: nvml snapshots every 20s, jemalloc stats, slot-usage histogram, and a short kernel-allocation trace. add `--nvml-snap --jemalloc --slot-hist --alloc-trace` flags to smoke job.
noah: for quality gating: run 100 long-context evals (our long-story set) and compare token-match and embedding-sim against fp16 baseline. rollback if token-mismatch > 1.5% or embedding-sim drop > 0.01.
dina: minor note — we saw a tiny quality skew on a code-heavy prompt family (token mismatch ~0.8%). include those 30 cases in the smoke.
infra-bot: deploybot: canary patch queued by dina — job #4290 started :hourglass_flowing_sand:
kim: if the smoke run passes, ramp plan: 10% traffic with slowstart (0.5x every 15m) for 2h, keep compactor_interval_s=180 and nvml snapshots at each step.
raf: if OOMs reappear despite controls, fallbacks: per-pod kv_max_slots cap OR temporarily serve int8 for any request > 700 tokens. both coarse but safe.
noah: long-term action: track slot-churn rate metric and add a pre-onboard gate that refuses int4 route defaults with prefetch >1 or max_new_tokens > 512. update onboarding checklist.
dina: I'll open the PR with route patch + safety rule + smoke runner flags. posting perf artifacts in the PR and linking here.
kim: thanks all — i'll hold rollback until PR merges and smoke completes. auto-rollback threshold: >2 OOMs in 60m.
infra-bot: deploybot: smoke run #4290 completed — artifacts uploaded to /artifacts/aegir14b/4290.tar.gz (summary pending).
raf: once artifacts are up, pls post slot-hist heatmap and nvml diffs. also add an entry to the onboarding doc: "int4 long-ctx: require slot-hist, nvml snapshots, conservative defaults".
kim: will do. follow-up after we review artifacts. thanks :thumbsup:
